notes: Both coders found the same two documents and almost the same units; 45 units matched. Only-one-coder units: A found 3 (instructor autonomy bounded by honesty policy, Option 1 encourage sentence, note on adapting disclosure templates), all kept. B found 5: 3 dropped as splits of sentences already coded (transformative-potential clause, 'is considered a violation' tail, IP/privacy clause) and 2 kept (assignment-specific instructions, Option 2 'should be used to enhance' sentence).
